question: How do we build a standard level 1 White Lion deck, and what are its movement and toughness?

record.title: White Lion level 1 attributes and deck construction
record.keywords: standard white lion level one level 1 attributes movement toughness speed damage ai deck construction build seven basic three advanced legendary hit location shuffle special cards setup
record.layout: The level 1 row on the White Lion story event lists B/A/L counts and attributes. Printed page 65 gives AI and hit-location deck construction; printed page 50 defines the columns. The reference card repeats the row.
record.summary: A standard level 1 White Lion uses 7 random Basic AI cards, 3 random Advanced AI cards, and no Legendary AI cards. It has movement 6 and toughness 8, with no listed extra speed or damage. Build this deck from the monster's separate shuffled type stacks, then combine and shuffle the selected cards. The First Story uses its own fixed deck and toughness 6.
notes: Set aside special AI cards before shuffling the Basic, Advanced, and Legendary stacks. Draw the indicated counts without looking. Put the resulting shuffled AI deck face down on the monster control panel.
Set up special cards and additional modifiers listed for the encounter separately in play; these do not enter the AI deck. The level 1 row has no listed special cards.
The standard hit-location deck uses all hit-location cards for that monster, shuffled face down. First Story instead sets Strange Hand on top as specified by its setup.

The reviewed row establishes card counts and attributes. A complete edition-specific inventory of every eligible AI and hit-location face is still missing, so this is not a complete deck-coverage claim.

response.answer:
A standard level 1 White Lion uses 7 random Basic AI cards, 3 random Advanced AI cards, and no Legendary AI cards. It has movement 6 and toughness 8, with no listed extra speed or damage. Build this deck from the monster's separate shuffled type stacks, then combine and shuffle the selected cards. The First Story uses its own fixed deck and toughness 6.

Set aside special AI cards before shuffling the Basic, Advanced, and Legendary stacks. Draw the indicated counts without looking. Put the resulting shuffled AI deck face down on the monster control panel.
Set up special cards and additional modifiers listed for the encounter separately in play; these do not enter the AI deck. The level 1 row has no listed special cards.
The standard hit-location deck uses all hit-location cards for that monster, shuffled face down. First Story instead sets Strange Hand on top as specified by its setup.
The reviewed row establishes card counts and attributes. A complete edition-specific inventory of every eligible AI and hit-location face is still missing, so this is not a complete deck-coverage claim.
